prose: Data-center roles in the US offer roughly a 42% pay premium for hourly maintenance and installation workers compared with similar jobs at other businesses, according to Indeed data reported by the Wall Street Journal. Powering the AI build-out requires physical work: walking sites, checking for burning smells and monitoring for bird damage.
highlights: Data-center maintenance and installation roles pay ~42% more than comparable jobs.
The figures come from Indeed data.
The work behind the AI build-out is hands-on: walking, smelling for burning, watching for bird damage.
